known_gaps.detail: Session Atlas is a long-running service that has to stay up, because the worktree removal guard fails closed when it cannot reach it. Until its definition is on the macbook-automations startup list, the job session-atlas-service installs it. That change to macbook-automations waits for the phase 1 close; docs/phase-1-close-checklist.md lists the two steps that move it and remove the installer. Ends with phase 1 close (JP-120).
known_gaps.label: com.josh360.session-atlas
